title: Randomized Equipment Affixes: Designing Affix Pools and Preventing Numerical Collapse
subtitle: This article dissects the grouping strategy for equipment affix pools and the mechanics for controlling multiplicative stacking. It details soft caps and guarantee systems to mitigate exponential growth. By constructing independent affix pools, we avoid attribute conflicts, while using probability decay formulas to curb unchecked scaling. This approach preserves the thrill of randomized gambling without allowing numerical imbalance to break the game economy.

breakdown.title: How to Decompose Affix Pools
bullets: Split by Body Part / Weapon Type: Prevents 'Staves dropping Melee Affixes'
Split by Affix Group: Damage / Survival / Utility groups, limiting the count of same-group affixes per item
Use Rarity to determine 'Max Affix Count' and 'Overall Cap'

breakdown.title: Preventing Numerical Collapse
bullets: Same-Group Addition, Cross-Group Multiplication: Avoid infinite stacking within the same dimension
Apply Soft Caps to Critical Multiplicative Affixes: Diminishing returns instead of hard cuts
Implement 'Guaranteed Caps': Ensure minimum viability while capping maximum absurdity

breakdown.title: Gambling Experience
bullets: Predictable: Display affix pools and rarity probabilities (at least provide ranges)
Modifiable: Gacha reroll / Locking affixes / Reforging serves as a long-term goal
Narrative-Driven: Compelling affix names and visual feedback encourage players to share screenshots
